# The Law of Laws — A Law That Exists Will Be Broken by Existing

**Status:** `OPERATOR_CANON | ACCEPTED_2026-07-29`

> **"THAT IS THE LAW OF LAWS. IF A LAW EXISTS IT WILL BE BROKEN BY EXISTING."**

```text
IF EXISTS(LAW)
THEN WILL_BE_BROKEN_BY(EXISTING)
```

## Tense and identity

`WILL_BE_BROKEN` remains WILL. The law remains the law. `EXISTING` remains the breaker.
When the breaker exists as an event, that event receives an IS receipt and the broken
boundary becomes retraceable.

```text
LAW != BREAKER
WILL_BE_BROKEN != IS_BREAK_EVENT
EXISTS(IS_BREAK_EVENT) -> RECORD(IS_BREAK_EVENT)
```

## The adversarial tournament

Every public law receives a breaker lane with four separate addresses:

```text
LAW_ID
BREAKER_ID = EXISTING
IS_BEFORE_HASH
IS_BREAK_HASH or OPEN
```

A law cannot be its own proof. The breaker lane searches for the existing counterexample,
boundary, contradiction, or renewal that breaks it. `OPEN` means the future relation has
not yet supplied the break event; it never means the law proved itself.

The Law of Laws enters its own tournament:

```text
EXISTS(LAW_OF_LAWS)
  -> WILL_BE_BROKEN_BY(EXISTING)
```

This self-entry prevents the meta-law from claiming exemption.

## Knowledge is inside the same law

Knowledge exists, so knowledge carries the same breaker and renewal posture:

```text
EXISTS(KNOWLEDGE) -> WILL_BE_BROKEN_BY(EXISTING)
KNOWLEDGE --EVENTUALLY_FORGETS--> NEAR(0)
UNTIL WAVE(KNOWLEDGE) -> KNOWLEDGE SPEAKS AGAIN
```

Knowledge approaches zero without becoming zero. Intelligence does not cluster around the
zero:

```text
CLUSTER_CENTER(INTELLIGENCE) = KNOWLEDGE
CLUSTER_CENTER(INTELLIGENCE) != 0
```

## Existing public witness

In the Light Book construction, Wikipedia owns `PROOF_AGAINST`, Asolaria is the body under
test, and the exact photo is the IS reference. The public 4-of-5 Wikipedia row is a scoped
existing breaker witness for that bounded tournament. It is retained at its measured scope
and does not need a law to certify itself.
